Artist.description:
A drawable node of an axes.

Every artist has a node identifier, an optional display name shown in the
legend, and a visibility flag. Future plot types are added as new variants.

oneOf.description: A polyline with optional markers (plot, plot3, loglog, semilogx, semilogy).
Markers at data points with per-point size and colour (scatter, scatter3).
Isolines or filled isobands of a gridded field (contour, contourf, contour3).
A gridded surface of faces (surf, mesh).

Axes.description: A plotting region placed in one or more cells of the figure's tile layout.

artists.description: The artists drawn in this axes, in drawing order.

box.description:
Whether the full outline of the plot box is drawn, rather than only the
edges that carry tick labels.

cell.description: The cells of the figure's tile layout that the axes occupies.

clim.description: The data values mapped to the first and last colours of the colormap.

colormap.description: The colormap used by colormapped artists in this axes.

id.description: The node identifier of the axes, unique within the figure.

legend.description: The legend, or `null` when no legend is shown.

projection.description: Whether the axes is two- or three-dimensional, with its 3D view.

title.description: The title drawn above the axes.

x.description: The horizontal axis in 2D, or the first horizontal axis in 3D.

y.description: The vertical axis in 2D, or the second horizontal axis in 3D.

z.description: The vertical axis in 3D; ignored by 2D axes.

Axis.description: One coordinate axis of an axes.

grid.description: Whether grid lines are drawn at the major ticks of this axis.

limits.description: The range of data values shown along the axis.

scale.description: The mapping from data values to positions along the axis.

AxisLink.description:
A group of axes whose limits along one dimension are kept equal.

For each dimension, the groups of a figure are disjoint: an axes belongs to at
most one group per dimension.

axes.description: The identifiers of the linked axes.

dimension.description: The dimension whose limits are linked.

Cell.description:
A rectangular block of cells in the figure's tile layout.

Rows and columns are numbered from zero, starting at the top-left cell.

col.description: The zero-based index of the leftmost column occupied.

col_span.description: The number of columns occupied; at least one.

row.description: The zero-based index of the top row occupied.

row_span.description: The number of rows occupied; at least one.

Color.description: An sRGB colour with straight alpha, written as #rrggbb when opaque or #rrggbbaa otherwise.

ColorSpec.description: How a colour is chosen for a stroke, fill or marker.

oneOf.description:
The renderer chooses the colour: for series this is the next colour of the
axes colour order (Okabe–Ito), and inside a scatter marker it is the scatter
colour.

The colour is taken from the axes colormap, indexed by the data value
scaled into the axes colour limits.

The perceptually uniform blue–yellow colormap designed for colour-vision
deficiency.

Contour.description: Isolines or filled isobands of a scalar field sampled on a grid.

display_name.description: The name shown for the artist in the legend.

fill.description:
Whether the bands between levels are filled (contourf) rather than only the
isolines drawn (contour).

grid.description: The grid on which the field is sampled.

id.description: The node identifier of the artist, unique within the figure.

levels.description: The field values at which isolines are drawn or between which bands are filled.

line.description: The style of the isolines; a colormapped colour takes each isoline's level.

placement.description: Where the contours are placed in 3D axes.

z.description: The field values, a two-dimensional array of shape `[ny, nx]`.

ContourPlacement.description: Where contours are placed in 3D axes.

oneOf.description: All contours lie in one horizontal plane (contour, contourf).

z.description:
The height of the plane in 3D axes, or `null` for the bottom of the z
axis; ignored by 2D axes.

oneOf.description:
Each isoline is drawn at the height of its level (contour3); valid only in
3D axes.

DashStyle.description: The dash pattern of a stroked line.

oneOf.description: A line of alternating dashes and dots.

DataId.description:
An identifier of a numeric array in the figure's data table.

Artists refer to their data by identifier rather than containing it, so that
several artists can share one array and the array is stored once.

Dimension.description: A coordinate dimension of an axes.

FigureSize.description: The physical size of a figure.

FontSetId.description: The identifier of a bundled font set.

oneOf.description: STIX Two Text for text and STIX Two Math for mathematics.

Grid.description: The grid on which a field of shape `[ny, nx]` is sampled.

oneOf.description: An axis-aligned grid defined by one coordinate vector per axis.

x.description: The x coordinates of the columns, an array of `nx` values.

y.description: The y coordinates of the rows, an array of `ny` values.

oneOf.description: A structured grid whose every node has its own coordinates.

x.description: The x coordinate of every node, an array of shape `[ny, nx]`.

y.description: The y coordinate of every node, an array of shape `[ny, nx]`.

Interpreter.description: How the source of a [`Text`] is interpreted.

oneOf.description: Mixed plain text and `$…$` LaTeX mathematics.
Plain text, rendered literally, including any dollar signs.

Legend.description: A legend listing the artists of an axes that have a display name.

boxed.description: Whether the legend is drawn with a background and outline.

location.description: Where the legend is placed inside the plot area.

LegendLocation.description: The placement of a legend inside the plot area.

oneOf.description: The centre of the top edge.
The centre of the bottom edge.
The centre of the right edge.
The centre of the left edge.
The corner that overlaps the least data.

Levels.description: The field values at which contours are drawn.

oneOf.description: Levels are chosen at nice values spanning the data range.
The range is computed from the data, rounded outwards to ticks.

max.description: The upper bound of the range.

min.description: The lower bound of the range.

Line.description:
A polyline through data points, with optional markers at the points.

The x, y and (in 3D) z arrays hold one value per point and must have the same
number of elements. Non-finite values break the line.

display_name.description: The name shown for the artist in the legend.

id.description: The node identifier of the artist, unique within the figure.

line.description: The style of the line through the points.

marker.description: The style of the markers at the points.

x.description: The x coordinates of the points.

y.description: The y coordinates of the points.

z.description:
The z coordinates of the points, allowed only in 3D axes; when absent in 3D
axes the points lie in the plane z = 0.

LineStyle.description: The style of a stroked line.

dash.description: The dash pattern of the line.

MarkerStyle.description: The style of the markers drawn at data points.

edge.description: The colour of the marker outline.

face.description: The colour of the marker interior.

size_pt.description: The marker size in points, measured as the width of the marker.

NdArray.description:
A dense, row-major, n-dimensional array of 64-bit floating-point values.

A two-dimensional array with `ny` rows and `nx` columns has shape `[ny, nx]`,
and the value in row `j` and column `i` is `values[j * nx + i]`. A missing value
is NaN. JSON has no representation for non-finite numbers, so every non-finite
value (NaN or an infinity) is written as `null` and read back as NaN.

shape.description: The length of each dimension, outermost first.

values.description: The values in row-major order; `null` denotes a missing value.

NodeId.description:
A stable identifier of a node (the figure, an axes or an artist).

Node identifiers are unique within a figure and remain unchanged when the figure
is saved and loaded, so that interaction state, links and future selections can
refer to nodes across sessions.

oneOf.description: A three-dimensional Cartesian axes viewed through an orthographic camera.

Provenance.description: A record of the software that produced a figure.

fonts.description: The names of the fonts used for text.

ironlab_version.description: The version of IronLAB that wrote the figure.

typesetter.description: The name and version of the mathematics typesetter.

Quiver.description:
Arrows representing a vector field at data points.

The position arrays and the component arrays hold one value per arrow and must
have the same number of elements.

display_name.description: The name shown for the artist in the legend.

head_size.description: The length of each arrow head as a fraction of its arrow's length.

id.description: The node identifier of the artist, unique within the figure.

line.description: The style of the arrow shafts and heads.

scale.description: How vector lengths are scaled into arrow lengths.

u.description: The x components of the vectors.

v.description: The y components of the vectors.

w.description:
The z components of the vectors, allowed only in 3D axes; when absent in 3D
axes the vectors lie in horizontal planes.

x.description: The x coordinates of the arrow tails.

y.description: The y coordinates of the arrow tails.

z.description:
The z coordinates of the arrow tails, allowed only in 3D axes; when absent in
3D axes the tails lie in the plane z = 0.

QuiverScale.description: How quiver vector lengths are scaled into arrow lengths.

oneOf.description: Arrows are scaled so that the longest does not overlap its neighbours.
The automatic scale is multiplied by a factor.

value.description: The multiplier applied to the automatic scale.

oneOf.description: Arrows are drawn with the vectors' lengths in data units.

Scale.description: The mapping from data values to positions along an axis.

oneOf.description:
Positions are proportional to the base-10 logarithm of values; non-positive
values are not drawn.

Scatter.description:
Markers at data points, each with its own size and colour.

The x, y and (in 3D) z arrays hold one value per point and must have the same
number of elements, as must any size or colour data.

color.description:
The colour of the markers, applied wherever `marker.face` or `marker.edge`
is `auto`.

display_name.description: The name shown for the artist in the legend.

id.description: The node identifier of the artist, unique within the figure.

marker.description: The marker shape and the use of the scatter colour for face and edge.

size.description: The size of the markers, which overrides `marker.size_pt`.

x.description: The x coordinates of the points.

y.description: The y coordinates of the points.

z.description:
The z coordinates of the points, allowed only in 3D axes; when absent in 3D
axes the points lie in the plane z = 0.

oneOf.description: Every marker has the same colour.
Each marker is coloured by a data value through the axes colormap.

data.description:
An array of values, one per point, mapped through the axes colormap and
colour limits.

oneOf.description: Every marker has the same size.

value.description: The marker size in points, measured as the width of the marker.

oneOf.description: Each marker has its own size.

data.description: An array of marker sizes in points, one per point.

Surface.description: A surface of quadrilateral faces over a grid (surf, mesh).

c.description:
The colour data of every node, with the same shape as `z`; when absent the
surface is coloured by `z`.

display_name.description: The name shown for the artist in the legend.

edge.description: The colour of the face edges.

edge_width_pt.description: The width of the face edges in points.

grid.description: The grid on which the surface is sampled.

id.description: The node identifier of the artist, unique within the figure.

z.description: The height of every node, a two-dimensional array of shape `[ny, nx]`.

Text.description: A piece of text, stored as its source so that renderers typeset it lazily.

content.description:
The source text. With the LaTeX interpreter, segments delimited by `$…$`
are typeset as mathematics and the remainder as plain text.

interpreter.description: How the source text is interpreted.

TileLayout.description: The grid of cells in which the axes of a figure are placed.

cols.description: The number of columns; at least one.

rows.description: The number of rows; at least one.

View3d.description: The orthographic camera view of a three-dimensional axes.

azimuth_deg.description:
The rotation about the vertical axis in degrees, measured counterclockwise
from the negative y axis when viewed from above.

elevation_deg.description: The angle of the view direction above the x-y plane in degrees, from -90 to 90.

pan.description:
The offset of the projected box as fractions of the plot area's width and
height.

zoom.description: The magnification of the projected box, where 1 fits the box to the plot area.

description: A figure: the root of the retained IR, holding axes, data and axis links.

axes.description: The axes of the figure, in drawing order.

background.description: The colour of the figure background.

data.description: The numeric arrays referenced by artists, keyed by data identifier.

font_set.description: The font set used for all text.

font_size_pt.description: The base font size in points; titles and tick labels are scaled from it.

id.description: The node identifier of the figure, unique within the figure.

layout.description: The grid of cells in which axes are placed.

links.description: The groups of axes whose limits are linked along a dimension.

provenance.description: A record of the software that produced the figure.

schema_version.description: The version of the figure schema that the file conforms to.

size.description: The physical size of the figure.

title.description: The title drawn above all axes (sgtitle).

title: Figure
